design: Post hoc structural-zero sensitivity. Preliminary manifest and lockfile inventories informed the choice of two strata. Check all unresolved newer Yarn candidates and all unresolved projects without a usable root lockfile in the specified intake statuses.
shared_rule: Require no root dependencies, optionalDependencies, peerDependencies, or bundled dependencies.
modern_yarn: Require a declared Yarn 3 or 4 manager, a version 6, 8 or 10 lockfile, and one matching root workspace locator whose lock dependencies agree with the manifest's devDependencies. Root workspaces are checked only at '.'; child workspaces are outside this scope.
missing_lockfile: Require no declared child workspaces and every supported lockfile and pnpm workspace probe to be HTTP 404. A structurally empty pinned manifest can supply the root zero without a concrete lockfile path.
outcome: Bound only the frozen mandatory root dependency estimand. Retain all original positives and report separately from the primary protocol.
